diagnosis: Three linked defects. (1) convert_response derives stop_reason from incomplete_details, then unconditionally overwrites it to tool_calls whenever any tool-call item exists, including partial fragments from an interrupted response; the content_filter/max_tokens signal is lost exactly when it matters. (2) The same function attaches those partial tool_calls to the assistant message, so downstream dispatch sees executable calls from a blocked or truncated response; stop metadata and dispatch are separate channels and both are wrong. (3) responses_stop_details returns StopDetails with explanation None for content_filter without refusal text, which the shared collector drops because it requires categories or explanation, leaving the block invisible. collect_stop_details is a shared defensive collector and is correctly left unchanged; the fix belongs in the provider extractor and converter.

patch_summary: convert_response: gate both the tool_calls stop override and the tool_calls forwarding on response completeness (incomplete_details is None), via one named flag; responses_stop_details: default nonempty explanation when content_filter has no refusal text; collect_stop_details: unchanged.
